# Sonarr 4.0 synthetic fixtures

Hand-authored 2026-09-23 from the published Sonarr API v3 shape; no live server data is included. Read paths are `/api/v3/system/status`, `/health`, `/queue`, `/series`, `/wanted/missing`, `/calendar`, and `/history`. Authentication uses `X-Api-Key` (value never captured). Fixtures contain synthetic IDs/titles and cover queue, health, monitored/missing, calendar and import history. Live version, enum and filter compatibility remains pending.
